items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Harrison Ball? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yes. He was a trumpet player too.

ctx.x: He died. He was a trumpet player too. Play trombone and baritone. Oh, Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer, he was nice. You know Lego?
No, I don't think so. You know Harrison Ball?
Oh yes. He was a trumpet player too.
